technology_name: AN INERTER-BASED BASE ISOLATION SYSTEM USING LINEAR MOTION GUIDE AND TENSION SPRINGS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Seismic Isolation Hardware / Structural Protection Device
problem_solved: Traditional base isolation systems struggle to damp high-frequency seismic acceleration forces effectively, risking massive foundation shear failures.
description: A novel utility model for structural defense comprising an integrated base isolation network equipped with a rolling base plate assembly, fluid-damped linear motion guides, precision tension springs, a rack-and-pinion transmission wheel, and a mechanical rotational inerter unit to amplify structural damping forces.
applications: Seismic foundation isolation for skyscrapers, sensitive semiconductor fabrication cleanroom platforms, emergency hospital grid protectors, and high-value cultural heritage monument preservation.
secondary_sector: Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Energy, Climate & Sustainability
